decision: PARTIAL -> W1 with a type decision: today's [48,72] is a highbush lo / rabbiteye hi blend (NCSU: 'Plant highbush varieties every 4-5 ft in the row and 8-10 ft between rows.' / 'Plant rabbiteye varieties 5-6 ft in the row and 10-12 ft between rows'). The default is the HIGHBUSH figure: the crop's own planting prose leads with highbush ('about 4 to 5 feet apart for highbush, 5 to 6 feet for the larger rabbiteye'), northern and southern highbush cover most of the roster's zones, and UGA C946 and Clemson give the same 4-5 ft for highbush. ncsu_ext -> in_row [48,60], row [96,120]. A rabbiteye entry waits on varieties[].plant_habit / a cultivar-type axis (not promote 1). The two prose restatements already split by type and keep the entry's highbush figure: agrees.
